surface_mechanism_description: The ALD process uses tetrakis[ethylmethylamino]vanadium (TEMAV) as the vanadium precursor and water or ozone as the oxygen source. The surface reactions involve the adsorption of TEMAV and subsequent reaction with water or ozone to form vanadium oxide phases. The exact chemical equations for the surface reactions are not explicitly provided in the text.
